parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Using Fig. 1.1, compare the US inflation rate between July and December 2020 with that
between January and June 2021.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Using the information provided, explain what is meant by ‘the US government’s economic
stimulus package’.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Consider the extent to which an increase in interest rates could reduce the rate of inflation in
the US.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
With the help of an AD/AS diagram, assess whether the rising inflation rate in the US has
been caused by changes to the demand side or changes to the supply side of the economy.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Assess the possible consequences of a rising rate of inflation for a country such as the US.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain the functions of price in resource allocation and consider the importance of these
functions in relation to the potential effectiveness of a market economy.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess whether all market economies should become mixed economies. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain the possible economic reasons for inequality of income and consider whether
inequality of income can benefit an economy.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
With the help of a diagram, assess whether the introduction of a minimum price in a market
can be justified. 
Section C
Answer one question.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain the circular flow of income in a closed economy and consider the extent to which the
circular flow of income changes as an economy becomes an open economy.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess whether the consequences of economic growth for an economy are always positive.

OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
With the help of a diagram, explain what is meant by an appreciation of a floating exchange
rate and consider whether a country can only benefit from the appreciation of its currency.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess whether supply-side policies are the most effective way to correct a deficit on the
current account of the balance of payments of an economy.
